profile.headline: Engineering at Uber
profile.summary: Looking to grow my career through experiments and tackling complex problems with data.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Led the effort of a scalable Payroll Risk platform for millions of daily payroll transactions to prevent millions of dollars in annual fraud losses
• Implemented an architecture for near real-time risk assessment of all QuickBooks Online and Desktop direct deposit payslips for fraud and compliance
• Led the launch of a money transmitter license & anti-money laundering program to comply with state-laws through an integration with a third-party tool for SAR report filings
• Oversaw the Payroll Risk product to facilitate timelines, organize backlog
• Contributed to several Apache Spark jobs to compute aggregations and backload data
• Technology & Craftmanship: Java, Spring Boot, Apache Tomcat, Apache Cassandra, Apache Storm, Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
• Led the AWS migration of the Payments Risk & Disputes platform, with over 10+ microservices
• Refactored over 10+ applications into String Boot/Apache Tomcat microservices and decoupled the
platform from local datacenter in support of cloud migration
• Deployed over 10+ CI/CD Jenkins pipelines and converted all batch jobs to AWS Lambda jobs
• Technology & Craftsmanship: Java, Apache Storm, Apache Cassandra, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Hibernate/JPA, Spring Security, Oracle, ActiveMQ

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
• Worked with mechanical engineers to learn CNC, prototype machining, and metal cutting
• Lathed and milled aluminum parts based off prototype engineer drawings
• Introduced to the designing and drafting with AutoCAD

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
